info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Submit Refund Request API
info.description: This API allows businesses to submit refund requests for transactions identified by a unique refund ID. Utilizing this endpoint is essential for managing customer service interactions, ensuring a seamless experience for users wanting to reverse transactions. Common consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, payment processing systems, and customer support applications looking to streamline refund processes. By automating refund submissions, businesses can improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

post.summary: Submit a refund request for a specific reservation.
post.description: This operation allows you to submit a refund request for the specified reservation identified by its unique ID. Ensure that all the necessary information is provided in the request to process the refund successfully.

requestBody.description: Submits a refund request for the specified transaction. The request must include all necessary details related to the refund being processed, following the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the refund has been submitted.
